coverage.scope: Fictional Lantern Docs supplied project corpus; no live Notion search

sources.title: Lantern Docs export policy
sources.content:
# Export policy
Status: accepted.
D-014: Standard workspace exports expire after 14 days.
Reason: keep download exposure bounded while allowing asynchronous handoffs.
D-007 is superseded by D-014.

D-014 relies on K-EXP for its exposure rationale.

sources.title: Historical export decision
sources.content:
# History
Status: superseded by D-014.
D-007: Standard workspace exports expire after 7 days.

sources.title: Longer retention experiment
sources.content:
# Experiment
Status: draft, not approved.
D-060: Standard workspace exports expire after 60 days.
We have not reviewed the exposure impact.

sources.title: Exposure review
sources.content:
# Exposure review
Accepted evidence for D-014: exported files can contain private draft documents.
A longer download window needs a new exposure review and user-facing copy check.

Status: open.

sources.title: Expiry cleanup task
sources.content:
# T-022
T-022 implements D-014: purge standard exports after 14 days.
Acceptance: expired download links return an expiry message.

Status: planned.

sources.title: Studio handoff goal
sources.content:
# Studio handoff goal
Status: accepted.
Help small creative studios hand off review documents to guests without requiring a recipient account.

sources.title: Fictional studio interviews
sources.content:
# Fictional studio interviews
Status: observed.
In six fictional interviews, four studios reported that recipient account creation delayed document handoff. These interviews did not measure demand for a 60-day window.

E-CUST supplies customer evidence for G-01.

sources.title: Fictional competitor comparison
sources.content:
# Fictional competitor comparison
Status: observed.
The invented Paper Kite product offers guest downloads for 3 days; invented Folder Finch offers account-based sharing. This two-product exercise is not a market census.

sources.title: Download authorization requirement
sources.content:
# Download authorization requirement
Status: accepted.
A standard export download must be refused at or after its expiry time, even if the stored file has not yet been purged.

R-01 implements the accepted retention rule D-014.

sources.title: Export expiry design
sources.content:
# Export expiry design
Status: accepted.
Store expires_at in UTC. Check expiry on every download request. A background cleanup task removes stored files independently.

A-01 implements R-01.

A-01 must address the cleanup delay risk K-RACE.

sources.title: Expiry boundary acceptance cases
sources.content:
# Expiry boundary acceptance cases
Status: accepted.
Test downloads immediately before, exactly at, and after expires_at. Reject tampered links. Test with the cleanup task deliberately delayed.

T-01 verifies the acceptance behavior in R-01.

sources.title: Fictional expiry test run
sources.content:
# Fictional expiry test run
Status: observed.
Fictional run: before-expiry download passed; at-expiry rejection failed when cleanup was delayed. This run does not establish release readiness.

V-01 reports observations from running T-01.

sources.title: Long retention conversion assumption
sources.content:
# Long retention conversion assumption
Status: unverified.
A 60-day export window might improve studio conversion. No conversion measurement currently supports this assumption.

sources.title: Retention decision question
sources.content:
# Retention decision question
Status: open.
How much retention do studios need, and what exposure is acceptable before changing D-014?

sources.title: Cleanup delay exposure
sources.content:
# Cleanup delay exposure
Status: open.
If download authorization relies on file deletion, a delayed cleanup task can leave expired links usable.

sources.title: Recruiting spreadsheet exports
sources.content:
# Recruiting spreadsheet exports
Status: observed.
Recruiters export interview scheduling spreadsheets. This record concerns hiring operations, not product document sharing.

sources.title: Enterprise archive exception
sources.content:
# Enterprise archive exception
Status: accepted.
Enterprise archival workspaces use a separately contracted retention policy.

sources.title: Other project export feedback
sources.content:
# Other project export feedback
Status: observed.
Fictional Orchard Notes customers requested bulk export for an unrelated personal notes product.
